## What's changed

- Gave the heavier ArtCNN Quality C4F32 shader more time to initialize during compatibility detection, preventing capable GPUs from being incorrectly marked unavailable and falling back to ArtCNN Balanced.
- Improved interrupted upscaling probe diagnostics so genuine timeouts and cancellations are reported clearly instead of appearing as an unexplained `signal: killed` failure.
- Added regression coverage for the extended ArtCNN Quality probe and clearer timeout reporting.

This is a server-side update; Tater Tube players do not need to be updated.
